_comment: Template for a daily tango session log. Copy to data/YYYY-MM-DD.json. A 'session' is any tango day: class, practica, milonga, or solo practice. Fill what's relevant; omit the rest. One file per date can hold multiple sessions (e.g. class then milonga same night) in the 'sessions' array.

sessions._type_options: class | practica | milonga | solo | festival | workshop
sessions._follower_experience_note: The scoreboard: did partners feel comfortable/musical? returned cabeceos? second tandas? any feedback?
sessions._carry_forward_note: The ONE thing to bring to next session.

_body_note: Fatigue, soreness, mobility — relevant to dissociation/posture/axis.
